text: {"lessons":["Selling winners feels satisfying, but I should not let that feeling make me exit solely to lock in a gain; consider each stock’s prospects and my overall plan.","Avoid holding a losing position just because admitting a purchase was a mistake hurts; reassess it objectively and sell when the reasons for owning it no longer hold.","Frequent checking and trading can encourage impulsive decisions, such as buying Stock B again at a higher price; set clear rules and weigh risk before acting."]}
